plugins.name: scoutflo
plugins.description: Read-only, scored audits of your infra and observability stacks (LGTM/VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, Sentry, PagerDuty, Datadog, ELK/Kibana, Prometheus alerting, DigitalOcean, GCP, AWS) with alert-noise/alert-fatigue scoring, guided hardening, Slack briefs, and scheduled runs. Runs entirely on your side with your credentials.
